#block(width: 100%)[
  #set par(leading: 0.62em)
  #text(size: 10pt, fill: rgb("#33322c"))[Lecturer in Applied Statistics at the University of Aberdeen. I carry out research across a range of fields, teach statistics from undergraduate to PhD level, and work with people from other disciplines to design and analyse their studies. Before this I spent nearly two years as a statistician at the Animal and Plant Health Agency, producing analysis within government. Across all of it, what I care about most is that the data and the model can actually answer the question being asked; only then does it matter that the results are made clear to the people who rely on them.]
